---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea for ZenCode AI
title: "[FEATURE] Brief description of the feature"
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## 📋 Feature Description

A clear and concise description of what the feature is.

Example: *As a [user type], I want [feature], so that [benefit].*

## 💡 Problem Statement

Is this feature related to a problem? Please describe the problem.

Example: *I'm always frustrated when [specific problem/limitation]...*

## 🎯 Proposed Solution

Describe the solution you'd like to see implemented.

## 🔄 Alternative Solutions

Have you considered any alternative approaches or features that might solve the problem?

## 📚 Use Cases

What are the primary use cases for this feature? When and how would users use it?

1. Use case 1: [description]
2. Use case 2: [description]
3. Use case 3: [description]

## 📐 Design/Implementation Thoughts

If you have ideas about how this could be implemented:

- Technical approach
- UI/UX considerations
- Performance implications
- Potential challenges

## 🔍 Examples or References

Provide examples from other projects or tools that have similar features.

- Example 1: [description and link]
- Example 2: [description and link]

## 👥 Impact

- How many users would benefit from this feature?
- What is the priority or urgency?
- Would this be a breaking change?

## 🎨 Mockups/Screenshots

If applicable, provide mockups, wireframes, or screenshots showing the proposed feature.

## 📝 Additional Context

Add any other context, information, or background here.

## ✅ Checklist

- [ ] I have checked that this feature doesn't already exist
- [ ] This feature would benefit multiple users
- [ ] I have provided clear use cases
- [ ] I have searched similar feature requests
- [ ] I understand this is a community project

---

Thank you for your suggestion! We appreciate community input. 🚀
